第一次中國教育年鑑 1934

The First China Education Yearbook (Diyici Zhongguo jiaoyu nianjian), 1934 — reprint volume 2: 丙編 (part), 丁編, 戊編
教育部 (Ministry of Education) 編; 開明書店 (Kaiming Bookstore), Shanghai, May 1934; 民國叢書 photo-reprint

PARTIAL EXTRACTION, because of the quality of the scan. Transcribed: all the statistical tables of 丁編 教育統計 (the statistical part, printed horizontally with Arabic figures), the tables and lists of the first part of 丙編 第二 社會教育概況 that had been read before the work was narrowed, the whole chronology 興學以來教育大事記 (1,567 entries, 1862–1932) with its list of sources, and the biographies 教育先進傳略 (102 entries). NOT transcribed: the rest of 丙編 (most of the tables and lists of libraries, museums, sports, study abroad and learned societies, printed vertically with compressed Chinese numerals), and the tables and lists of 戊編 (officials, donors, the surveys of foreign education); 丙編 第一 學校教育概況 is in the other reprint volume, so its contents entries have no scan link. The type of the scan is badly broken in places: in the Arabic tables a 4 often prints like a 1, and 3/5/8 and 0/6/9 lose strokes; in the Chinese tables the digits are compressed two to a character space. Every page was surveyed on contact sheets by Claude Sonnet; tables with Chinese numerals and most statistical tables were read by Claude Opus from enlarged crops, re-adding every printed total to catch misreads; some earlier tables (丁編 pp. 30–47, 54–74 and 94–101, and most 丙編 lists) were read by Claude Sonnet, which an independent check found less reliable (about 94–99% of figures right). A printed total never settled a digit except the 一/二/三 and 3-vs-8 rules; 55 cells that a reader had settled from totals in other ways were turned back into [?]. Totals that do not reconcile are kept as printed with a note. In all 1,440 of about 33,000 figure cells (4.4%) are marked [?].
